description: This file contains abstract JUnit test cases for implementations of the SignalEnrichmentFacade interface, testing behaviors such as retrieving partial things, handling exceptions, timeouts, and event filtering.

classes.name: AbstractSignalEnrichmentFacadeTest
classes.description: Abstract base test class providing common tests for different SignalEnrichmentFacade implementations. It tests successful retrieval, error handling, timeouts, and event processing behaviors.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Tests that retrievePartialThing() successfully retrieves and returns the expected JSON object.

methods.name: thingNotAccessible
methods.description: Tests that retrievePartialThing() fails appropriately when the thing is not accessible, throwing a ThingNotAccessibleException.

methods.name: unexpectedMessage
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the response from the retrievePartialThing() handler returns an unexpected (non-expected) object.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Tests that retrievePartialThing() times out appropriately when there is no response within the specified timeout duration.

methods.name: dontEnrichThingDeleted
methods.description: Verifies that when a ThingDeleted event is received, no retrieval message is sent and no enrichment occurs.

methods.name: createSignalEnrichmentFacadeUnderTest
methods.description: Abstract method to instantiate the facade under test with a specified timeout duration.

methods.name: actualSelectedFields
methods.description: Override point for subclasses to validate or transform the selected fields used in retrievePartialThing.

methods.name: getThingResponseThingJson
methods.description: Provides a sample JSON representation of a Thing response used in test assertions.

methods.name: getExpectedThingJson
methods.description: Returns the expected JSON object for comparison in successful retrieval tests.
